nameOrigin: large reptile with a protective shell

pokedexEntries.rb: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

pokedexEntries.ye: When tapped, this POKéMON will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

pokedexEntries.go: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that WARTORTLE is very old.

pokedexEntries.si: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

pokedexEntries.cr: Its long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity, making it quite popular among older people.

pokedexEntries.rs: Its tail is large and covered with a rich, thick fur. The tail becomes increasingly deeper in color as WARTORTLE ages. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this POKéMON’s toughness as a battler.

pokedexEntries.fr: This POKéMON is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.

pokedexEntries.lg: It often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For fast swimming, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

pokedexEntries.em: Its large tail is covered with rich, thick fur that deepens in color with age. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this POKéMON’s toughness in battle.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

pokedexEntries.hg: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that WARTORTLE is very old.

pokedexEntries.ss: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.
